MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The pressure and temperature sensor gives me a plausible new project using my breadboards, wiring and circuit-building supplies, provided it is compatible.",
    "The tactile switches fit my electronics projects, although I would check the switches left from my PCB kit before choosing a pack of 100."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The printer filaments assume equipment and a printing need that my electronics purchases do not establish.",
    "The 12V automotive relay harnesses do not directly match my previous 5V relay module; their purpose and electrical requirements matter more than the shared word relay.",
    "Another caster set feels unnecessary after my recent purchase of heavy-duty casters with leveling capability.",
    "The tabletop resin, glass vials, honing guide and sheet-metal screws require specific projects I have not shown a need for."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in building circuits seems to have been stretched into an assumed interest in almost any DIY material or workshop tool.",
    "Buying a component or a set of wheels seems to have been taken as a reason to suggest similar purchases without considering whether I already have enough."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I need parts that work with my existing supplies; voltage, connections and intended use determine whether a related item is useful.",
    "My existing PCB kit already included switches, so quantity and remaining supplies affect whether more switches are worth choosing.",
    "A useful addition should support a plausible next project, while a replacement needs a clear reason, especially after my recent caster purchase."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions partly recognize my circuit-building interests but assume too many unrelated projects and repeat needs I may already have filled."
}
